**What are Parallel Universes?**

The basic idea is that our universe – everything we can observe – might not be the *only* universe. Instead, there could be other universes existing alongside ours, potentially with different physical laws, constants, histories, and even dimensions. These aren’t truly *different* universes in the sense of having different physics, just distant regions within our own.
